Russell fastest in Italian Grand Prix practice session

George Russell of Mercedes set the fastest lap during the second practice session for the Italian Grand Prix at Monza. He surpassed times set by Ferrari drivers and Antonelli. The session saw Russell reclaim a leading position for Mercedes.
